title: Karbobala naseeb se jaana naseeb ho
body:
Karbobala naseeb se jaana naseeb ho
Karbobala nassib se jana
<<DIVIDER>>
Nassib ho karbobala nassib se jana
Phir laut kar wahan se na aana
<<DIVIDER>>
Nassib ho
Aisa dare Hussain pe sajda ho akhri x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Phir mujhko apna sar na outhana
Nassib ho..
<<DIVIDER>>
Parvardigar thokarein dar dar ki kab talak x2
Ab mutakil najaf me thikana
<<DIVIDER>>
Nassib ho
Jaisa mila nassib se oummoul baneen ko x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Ab kya kissi ko aisa gharana
Nassib ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Ji tchahta hai samne bethe ho Panjetan x2
Ounki sanah ounhi ko sounana
<<DIVIDER>>
Nassib ho
Ankhon ko jab bhi ashk bahana nassib ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Aale Nabi ke gham ka bahana
Nassib ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Mehshar ye arzoo hai ke be ghuslo be kafan x2
Karbobala ki teh me samaana
<<DIVIDER>>
Nassib ho
Phir laut kar wahan se na aana nassib ho
author: Mir Hassan Mir
